responsibility: Declares the core Resolver2_0 scope-binding types: the Namespace enum, DuplicateNameError, and the Rib container with its nested Definition representation. It specifies the per-scope name table used by ForeverStack, including rib kinds that encode resolution barriers such as modules, functions, traits, impls, closures, and special generic-parameter contexts, along with the API for inserting and retrieving names while tracking whether a binding may be shadowed or become ambiguous.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Rib abstraction and related types such as Namespace, DuplicateNameError, Rib::Definition, and Rib::Kind, defining the shape of per-scope binding tables and rib categories; the paired .cc file implements the insertion, ambiguity, and lookup semantics behind those declarations.
